units.source_text: 手指深深地扒在沙子里，隐隐有些生疼，

en.t: His fingers dug deep into the sand, aching faintly,

units.source_text: 它吊住了全身的重量，数到十就跳出去……

en.t: they held up the weight of his whole body; he would count to ten and jump out...

units.source_text: 谁知数到十三下，他还没想好，

en.t: but even after he had counted to thirteen, he still had not made up his mind,

units.source_text: 然后，他又重重地深呼吸了四下，总算下定了决心。

en.t: then he took four more heavy, deep breaths and finally made his decision.
